items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think you told me already. S.H. Rye? Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: I got a rag sometime on a piano. And after I played a beautiful thing. Then if I'm around you, I'll tell you the name of it.
I think you told me already. S.H. Rye? Yeah.
